paper_title: BICEP / Keck XIV: Improved constraints on axion-like polarization oscillations in the cosmic microwave background
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, computed from g < 4.5e-12*(m/1e-21 eV)
notes: CMB polarization oscillation search (time-variable cosmic birefringence) constraining axion-photon coupling. Median 95% CL limit for periods 1-30 d: g_agamma < (4.5e-12 GeV^-1)*(m/1e-21 eV), valid for 1.6e-21 <= m <= 4.8e-20 eV, assuming axions are all DM with rho=0.3 GeV/cm^3. The two emitted points span this validity range with the linear g~m scaling (at m=1.6e-21: 7.2e-12; recomputed exactly). Full mass range covered is 1e-23 to 1e-18 eV but the quoted best-sensitivity band is used.
